name: dsh-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness Windows desktop client — an Electron shell that boots the local dsh web server in a desktop window and self-updates from GitHub Releases.

scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime && npm run build:runtime-zip && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:publish: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime && npm run build:runtime-zip && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always
